title: The README that gets the project understood in sixty seconds

videos.script: The README is the page most reviewers read, and many read nothing else. It has about a minute to answer three questions: what is this, does it work, and is the person who made it someone I want to talk to. {{minute}} Most READMEs answer none of them. They open with installation steps for a project the reader cannot yet picture, or with a paragraph about the technology instead of the problem. {{most}} loanbook's README answers all three. Its run instructions were tested on a machine where it had never run. And its most useful section is the one most READMEs leave out: the decisions, with their costs.
